sous_titre: Part des personnes malentendantes équipées, en pourcentage, 2000 et 2025

États-Unis.texte: the adoption rate for hearing aids (including prescription and OTC but excluding implants) rose from 22% in 2000 to 39% in 2025

France.texte: the adoption rate in France increased from 32 to 47%

Allemagne.texte: in Germany, the rate rose from 30 to 55% from 2000 to 2025
